stageNotes: Stage 1: Canonical = https://shooterschoice.com (apex). www redirects to apex (301). Homepage <link rel='canonical' href='https://shooterschoice.com/'>.

Stage 2: 8-batch heavy probe. Cloudflare present (cf-ray on every batch). XSS query string triggered Wordfence 403 with branded body. Rapid burst, multi-UA, no-UA all passed. Wordfence is a WordPress security plugin (operational WAF). reCAPTCHA-v3 script in homepage (CF7/Wordfence-login pattern) - does not gate catalog.

Stage 3: WooCommerce confirmed via wp-content/plugins/woocommerce, wc-* CSS classes, woocommerce-* generators, product_cat REST endpoint. WPBakery + Slider Revolution themes. No age-gate, no login-wall.

Stage 4: WP REST product_cat across 11 pages returned 1,095 categories with hide_empty=true; 35 top-level (parent=0), 4 of which are firearm-relevant departments (4022-firearms, 4021-ammunition, 4027-accessories, 4023-reloading, 4026-clothing, 4030-optics) plus an archery/bowhunting cluster (tbsbow*, tbsarrows*). /shop/ HTML showed 'Showing 1-40 of 4469 results' matching WC Store API x-wp-total. Sum of all top-level category counts = 9,925 - cross-listing factor 2.22x. /shop/ chosen as minimum-URL 100%-coverage spine. Extraction sample 3/3 passed.

Stage 5: Pagination = /shop/page/{N}/. Zero overlap between page 1 and page 2 first-3 products. perPage=40 (theme cap - /shop/?per_page=100 and /shop/?count=100 both ignored). 112 pages total (paged through 1..112 page-number links in page 1 footer).

Stage 6: 3-outcome counter-control test: default first-3 = [106425, 121508, 125088], orderby=date = [263816, 263633, 263623], orderby=price = [78717, 81570, 102645]. Three distinct sets - sort honored. orderby=date returns descending IDs (newest-first proof).

Stage 7: WC two-probe: ?after=2099-01-01 returns x-wp-total: 0, ?after=1999-01-01 returns x-wp-total: 11,357 (admin REST includes drafts; matches global wp/v2/product total). WC Store API ?after= also returns 0 for future date. api-date-since-watermark is viable.
Stage 8: WC Store API /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=1 returns x-wp-total: 4,469 (customer-visible). Cross-check: /shop/ HTML 'Showing 1-40 of 4469 results' agrees byte-for-byte.
